title: Concept: Dependency pinned to a placeholder zero version
description: package.json declares a pin to `0.0.0`, the placeholder version package managers publish before a real release, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The placeholder usually means an unpublished or local-only artifact, so the dependency resolves differently on any machine without the same local state.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The placeholder usually means an unpublished or local-only artifact, so the dependency resolves differently on any machine without the same local state.
